name: Mizusawa Reiji
source:
A 3rd year student with few friends, when school is finished he usual heads straight home to work on his hobbies. He is of the belief that boys should be fully interested in the opposite sex but unfortunately he only has his right hand to keep him company.

He is a complete average looking guy and since his parents are away for work he lives with his sister.
